counterfactual_missing_items: family history of similar vision problems
detailed description of the patient's visual field defects
decisive_items: symmetric hypoautofluorescent lesions with hyperautofluorescent borders in the central macula bilaterally
thinning of the outer nuclear layer in the fovea
attenuated photopic responses and 30-Hz flicker responses with delayed implicit times in both eyes
response.rationale: R1 is the champion because its raw support spans, such as symmetric hypoautofluorescent lesions and thinning of the outer nuclear layer, are highly specific to Stargardt disease. R3, the runner-up, has some similar support spans, but they are less specific to cone-rod dystrophy.

rejected.why: R4's support spans are less specific to macular dystrophy and do not provide a clear diagnosis.
C1 is an append-only completion of R3 and does not provide a distinct diagnosis.
